content.text: Meaning of world in English worldnoun us Your browser doesn't support HTML5 audio /wɝːld/ uk Your browser doesn't support HTML5 audio /wɜːld/ world noun (THE EARTH) Add to word list Add to word list A1 [ S ] the earth and all the people, places, and things on it: Different parts of the world have very different climatic conditions.in the world Which bridge has the longest span in the world?the whole world News of the disaster shocked the whole world.the entire world Climate change affects the entire world.changing world We live in a changing world and people must learn to adapt.world authority She's a world authority on fetal development.world record He set a new world record in the 100 m dash.world championship They're going to the world championships. People from different cultures have different conceptions of the world.The richer countries of the world should take concerted action to help the poorer countries.I'm flirting with the idea of taking a year off and traveling round the world.He's one of the highest-earning professional golfers in the world.The museum's collection includes works of art from all around the world. This argument may seem arcane to those not closely involved in the world of finance.He was considered as something of a maverick in the publishing world.They are unable to see beyond the narrow world of the theater.Stars from the world of entertainment turned out to celebrate his 40th year in show business.She was a key figure in the international art world. The rapid growth of computers has changed the world. [ U ] The world can also mean the whole physical universe: The world contains many solar systems, not just ours. world noun (WHOLE AREA) [ C ] all of a particular group or type of thing, such as countries or animals, or a whole area of human activity or understanding: the animal/plant world the business world the world of entertainment In the world of politics, the president’s voice is still the most powerful in the nation. world noun (LARGE DEGREE) [ U ] a large degree; a lot: There’s a world of difference between the two hotels. From NPR More than 300,000 podcasts exist in the world as of the close of 2015. From The Atlantic This is the world we are headed toward. From TIME The book goes out into the world, and who knows? From The Atlantic This will make the world a better place. From CNN We're all coming together towards making the world a better place. From Voice of America It's what people in 3rd and 4th world countries do. From CNN And as the world for birds goes, our world can't be far behind. From National Geographic Budgets fool us into believing that they will not only tame us, but the world around us as well. From New York Daily News But what in the world was that album all about? From TIME It's a fun world to be a part of. From VentureBeat It's bringing those worlds together that most interests me. From NJ.com Is the world a better place for having you and your work a part of it? From Fast Company Start paying attention to the physical world around you.
